# co-equal facet

Marks a property as one co-equal identity-facet axis among peers (CONSTITUTION P9, #281). Every property annotated coequalFacet true is held orthogonal to every other by the generated reasoning lint: its range is its own (distinct from every other axis), no rdfs:subPropertyOf or owl:equivalentProperty bridge may connect two axes, none may be owl:FunctionalProperty (a single locked value invites exactly the owl:sameAs collapse Principle 5 forbids), and all axis ranges must be jointly declared owl:AllDisjointClasses. A new annotated axis receives Principle 9 enforcement by construction.

**IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/coequalFacet>  
**CURIE:** `gmeow:coequalFacet`
